media_manifest.alt_text: Horizontal bars show weekly inventory changes for the week ending 30 October 2026: crude excluding SPR minus 0.9 million barrels, gasoline minus 0.2 million, and distillate minus 3.6 million. All bars share a million-barrel scale and zero reference.
media_manifest.attribution: U.S. Energy Information Administration · 4 Nov 2026 report, week ending 30 Oct. Independent chart: Capital Chronicle.
media_manifest.caption: EIA reported weekly stock declines of 0.9 million barrels for crude excluding SPR, 0.2 million for gasoline and 3.6 million for distillate. Selected products do not constitute a full decomposition of the total petroleum-stock change. Sources: [U.S. Energy Information Administration · 04 Nov 2026](https://ir.eia.gov/secure/wpsr/summary.txt).
